blogs.title: Breaking the Speed Limit: How FlashAttention-3 Unlocks 75% GPU Utilization on H100s
blogs.description: This post dives into the performance breakthroughs of FlashAttention-3, explaining how it achieves up to 2x speedups over its predecessor. We'll demystify the concept of 'asynchrony' and 'warp-specialization,' showing how separating data movement from computation allows modern GPUs like the H100 to finally run attention mechanisms at near-maximum efficiency.

blogs.title: The Art of Multitasking: Hiding Softmax Behind Matrix Multiplications
blogs.description: One of the biggest bottlenecks in AI isn't just math—it's waiting. This article explores the clever 'pingpong scheduling' technique used in FlashAttention-3. Learn how the algorithm overlaps slow mathematical operations (like softmax) with fast matrix multiplications, ensuring that powerful Tensor Cores never sit idle while waiting for other calculations to finish.

blogs.title: Going FP8 Without Losing Your Mind: Solving the Accuracy Problem in Low-Precision AI
blogs.description: Switching to FP8 (8-bit floating point) can double processing speed, but it often ruins model accuracy due to 'outlier' numbers. This post explains how FlashAttention-3 solves this dilemma using 'block quantization' and 'incoherent processing.' We'll break down how spreading out extreme values allows models to run faster and cheaper without sacrificing the intelligence users expect.
